defect_being_corrected: the previous architecture test only asserted torch.isfinite(output).all(), which a sigmoid-squashed output would also satisfy -- it did not mechanically distinguish a raw logit from a bounded probability.
correction: tests/test_model_v2_architecture_specs.py now requires, per architecture, BOTH a structural check and a behavioral check.

MODEL_V2_CAPCTRL.probe_method: final Linear head (model.output) weight zeroed, bias set to 2.0; forward pass on random synthetic input reproduces 2.0 exactly (atol=1e-5), and does NOT match sigmoid(2.0)=0.8808

probe_validated_as_discriminating.method: a deliberately sigmoid-wrapped subclass of ModelV2CapCtrl was constructed ad hoc (not committed) and run through the same probe: output was 0.8808 (sigmoid(2.0)), which correctly FAILED the 'output==2.0' assertion and correctly MATCHED the 'output==sigmoid(bias)' negative-check -- confirming the probe would have caught a real squashing defect had one existed
